manifest.name: dsh-enhance-prompt
manifest.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: a composer button that rewrites the current draft into a clearer, more specific prompt with your own configured model, and can restore the draft it replaced.
manifest.author: dsh-enhance-prompt contributors

readme.text:
**Turn a rough draft into a precise prompt — one click, right inside DeepSeek Harness.**

[English](./README.md) · [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md)

[](LICENSE)
[](https://www.deepseek.com)
[]()
[](#-privacy--data-flow)

One click turns your draft into a clear, specific prompt. Not happy?
One more click reverts it.

[Features](#-features) · [Installation](#-installation) · [Configuration](#%EF%B8%8F-configuration) · [Privacy](#-privacy--data-flow)
---

| | |
|---|---|
| **One-click rewrite** | One tap on ✨ turns your draft into a clear prompt. |
| **Answers, not questions** | Missing details? It fills them in and marks them "Assume: …" — no back-and-forth. |
| **Instant revert** | Click ↺ to restore. Start typing and the offer disappears. |
| **Cancel anytime** | Click the spinner to cancel; it stops on its own after 60 seconds. |
| **Language preserved** | Chinese stays Chinese, English stays English, mixed stays mixed. |
| **Protects @ references** | Drafts with @ chips are left untouched, so references never break. |
| **Bilingual UI** | Follows the app language, switches live. |
| **Zero footprint** | No storage, no caching, no telemetry. |

Open the plugin installer in DeepSeek Harness and paste **one** of the following: | Source | Paste this | |---|---| | npm
_recommended_ | `dsh-enhance-prompt` | | GitHub | `https://github.com/devilzyl/dsh-enhance-prompt` | | Local folder | the absolute path to a checkout of this repository | > [!NOTE] > If the npm name does not resolve yet, use the GitHub or local-folder source. After installing or updating the plugin, **refresh the page once** before use.
Remove the bundle named `dsh-enhance-prompt` from the plugin manager.

Works out of the box. To adjust, edit the plugin row's `config` in the bundle patch:

```yaml
- id: prompt-enhance
  config:
    maxInputChars: 4000      # draft limit; longer drafts return 413
    maxOutputTokens: 1024    # output ceiling for the rewrite

- **What is sent** — Only the plain text of your draft. No attachments, no files, nothing from other sessions.
- **Where it goes** — To your local Harness, then to the model provider **you** configured. The plugin never goes online by itself and never sees your API keys.
- **What is stored** — Nothing. No files, no cache, no telemetry.
- **Who can call it** — Only a logged-in browser session (401 otherwise); cross-site requests are rejected (403); if the auth service is down, everything is refused (503).

**草稿随手写，提示词一键成。** [English](./README.md) · [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md) [](LICENSE) [](https://www.deepseek.com) []() [](#-隐私与数据流) 安装后，输入框工具行会多出一个 ✨ 按钮。点一下，草稿就变成一份清晰、 具体的提示词；不满意，再点一下就还原。 [功能](#-功能) · [安装](#-安装) · [配置](#%EF%B8%8F-配置) · [隐私](#-隐私与数据流) ---

| | |
|---|---|
| **一键改写** | 点一下 ✨，草稿就变成清晰的提示词。 |
| **给结果，不提问** | 缺信息就按常理补上，标一句「假设：…」，不反问你。 |
| **随时还原** | 点 ↺ 恢复原文；你一开始打字，还原按钮自动消失。 |
| **可取消、不空等** | 转圈时再点一下就取消；60 秒没结果自动停下。 |
| **语言不变** | 中文还是中文，英文还是英文，混排也保持混排。 |
| **保护 @ 引用** | 草稿里有 @ 引用就先不改，避免把引用弄丢。 |
| **界面双语** | 跟随界面语言，中英文自动切换。 |
| **不留痕迹** | 不存储、不缓存、没有遥测。 |

打开 DeepSeek Harness 的插件安装入口，粘贴下面**任意一种**： | 来源 | 粘贴内容 | |---|---| | npm
_推荐_ | `dsh-enhance-prompt` | | GitHub | `https://github.com/devilzyl/dsh-enhance-prompt` | | 本地目录 | 本仓库检出的绝对路径 | > [!NOTE] > 如果 npm 上还搜不到这个包名，就先用 GitHub 或本地目录方式安装。 安装或更新插件后，**刷新一次页面**再使用。
在插件管理器里移除名为 `dsh-enhance-prompt` 的 bundle 即可。

开箱即用，无需配置。想调整就改插件补丁里的 `config`：

```yaml
- id: prompt-enhance
  config:
    maxInputChars: 4000      # 草稿字数上限，超出返回 413
    maxOutputTokens: 1024    # 改写结果的长度上限

- **发什么** —— 只有你输入的草稿文字。附件、文件、其他会话的内容，一概不碰。
- **发到哪** —— 先到本机的 Harness，再发给你自己配置的模型服务。插件自己不联网，也拿不到你的 API 密钥。
- **留什么** —— 什么都不留。不写文件、不缓存、没有遥测。
- **谁能用** —— 只有已登录的浏览器能调用；跨站请求一律拒绝；鉴权服务不可用时，所有请求都拒绝。
